key: GRUNT: You can't take all of us!
en: GRUNT: You can't take all of us!
ja: したっぱ: オレたち全員を　倒せるもんか!

key: GRUNT: Now you've done it...!
en: GRUNT: Now you've done it...!
ja: したっぱ: よくも　やってくれたな……!

key: AMARIA: ...So much for that idea.
en: AMARIA: ...So much for that idea.
ja: アマリア: ……この手は　だめみたいね

key: They sure got together quick.
en: They sure got together quick.
ja: 集まってくるのが　早すぎるわ

key: \PN.
en: \PN.
ja: \PN

key: Do you trust me?
en: Do you trust me?
ja: わたしを　信じてくれる?

key: AMARIA: Thank you. Then, get ready.
en: AMARIA: Thank you. Then, get ready.
ja: アマリア: ありがとう。じゃあ　準備して

key: AMARIA: Right...
en: AMARIA: Right...
ja: アマリア: そうよね……

key: Why would you, after all?
en: Why would you, after all?
ja: 信じる理由なんて　ないもの

key: I hope to earn that trust now.
en: I hope to earn that trust now.
ja: 今から　その信頼を　勝ち取ってみせる

key: So just this once, follow my lead, okay?
en: So just this once, follow my lead, okay?
ja: だから　今回だけは　わたしについてきて?

key: AMARIA: Deliverance!
en: AMARIA: Deliverance!
ja: アマリア: デリバランス!

key: AMARIA: Use Ice Shard right there!
en: AMARIA: Use Ice Shard right there!
ja: アマリア: そこよ　こおりのつぶて!

key: AMARIA: Go, \PN, run!
en: AMARIA: Go, \PN, run!
ja: アマリア: 行って　\PN! 走って!

key: METEOR GRUNT: Now you're in for it!
en: METEOR GRUNT: Now you're in for it!
ja: メテオだんしたっぱ: 覚悟しやがれ!

key: AMARIA: Atlantica, help me out!
en: AMARIA: Atlantica, help me out!
ja: アマリア: アトランティカ　力を貸して!

key: AMARIA: All right, guys. Let's do this!
en: AMARIA: All right, guys. Let's do this!
ja: アマリア: よし　みんな。いくわよ!

key: Don't worry about me, \PN, I'll be fine!
en: Don't worry about me, \PN, I'll be fine!
ja: わたしは大丈夫　\PN! 心配しないで!

key: Just find a way to shut down that PULSE!
en: Just find a way to shut down that PULSE!
ja: あなたは　あのPULSEを止める方法を　探して!

key: ACE: Ah, you've broken through, have you...
en: ACE: Ah, you've broken through, have you...
ja: エース: おや　突破してきたのか……

key: I'll hand it to that Gym Leader, she didn't hesitate to make an opportunity.
en: I'll hand it to that Gym Leader, she didn't hesitate to make an opportunity.
ja: あのジムリーダーは　大したものだ　ためらいなく　好機を作り出した

key: I admit I wasn't expecting you to split up, and yet...
en: I admit I wasn't expecting you to split up, and yet...
ja: 二手に分かれるとは　予想外だったよ。それにしても……

key: Perhaps a slow clap for the good show is in order.
en: Perhaps a slow clap for the good show is in order.
ja: この名演には　ゆっくりとした拍手が　ふさわしいかな

key: ACE: Yours truly again, dear fan.
en: ACE: Yours truly again, dear fan.
ja: エース: また俺の登場だ　親愛なるファンよ

key: I'd hoped not to have to perform like this now, but it seems that it was simply not in the stars.
en: I'd hoped not to have to perform like this now, but it seems that it was simply not in the stars.
ja: こんな形で演じたくは　なかったが　星の巡りが　そうさせなかったらしい

key: ...Would you believe, even now, that I am simply pretending to be a double agent, working for them that I might better serve you?
en: ...Would you believe, even now, that I am simply pretending to be a double agent, working for them that I might better serve you?
ja: ……今でも信じるかい? 俺は二重スパイのふりをして　キミのために　連中に仕えているのだと

key: ACE: Ah, I am like a fairy-- your belief gives me strength.
en: ACE: Ah, I am like a fairy-- your belief gives me strength.
ja: エース: ああ　俺は妖精のようなもの――キミの信じる心が　力になる

key: ACE: ...A pity.
en: ACE: ...A pity.
ja: エース: ……残念だ

key: Well, I'd hoped to preserve this balancing act for longer, but alas--
en: Well, I'd hoped to preserve this balancing act for longer, but alas--
ja: この綱渡りを　もっと続けたかったが　ああ――

key: It appears that more dire things than my own wishes are at stake here.
en: It appears that more dire things than my own wishes are at stake here.
ja: 俺の望みより　重大なものが　かかっているようだ

key: For the mask to come off so soon, I am disheartened!
en: For the mask to come off so soon, I am disheartened!
ja: こんなに早く　仮面を外すはめになるとは　がっかりだよ!

key: ACE: Crestfallen!
en: ACE: Crestfallen!
ja: エース: 意気消沈!

key: ACE: Inconsolably melancholic!
en: ACE: Inconsolably melancholic!
ja: エース: 慰めようもなく　ゆううつ!

key: ...Can't you tell?
en: ...Can't you tell?
ja: ……分からないかい?

key: To double on double... that was Borealis' charade, not mine.
en: To double on double... that was Borealis' charade, not mine.
ja: 二重の上に二重……あれはボレアリスの茶番　俺のじゃない

key: A magician of my caliber needs not claim others' tricks to be their own.
en: A magician of my caliber needs not claim others' tricks to be their own.
ja: 俺ほどの手品師は　他人の手品を　自分のものだと　言い張らない

key: And while the true performer should never spill their secrets, how about I offer you something of a compromise?
en: And while the true performer should never spill their secrets, how about I offer you something of a compromise?
ja: 真の演者は　秘密を明かさないもの　だが　折衷案なら　どうだい?

key: ACE: Reveal #1!
en: ACE: Reveal #1!
ja: エース: 種明かし　その1!

key: My lies were few; my truths were half.
en: My lies were few; my truths were half.
ja: 俺のうそは　わずか。真実は　半分

key: I WAS fired-- from my prior role only.
en: I WAS fired-- from my prior role only.
ja: 俺は確かにクビになった――前の役目からは　な

key: On a new task, I hope to please as ever I have.
en: On a new task, I hope to please as ever I have.
ja: 新しい任務でも　いつも通り　楽しませてやるよ

key: Borealis leaked our data, true!
en: Borealis leaked our data, true!
ja: ボレアリスがデータを漏らしたのは　本当さ!

key: And with a few beeps of the buttons-- I've booped my own failures away!
en: And with a few beeps of the buttons-- I've booped my own failures away!
ja: そしてボタンをピッピッと――自分の失敗は　ポチッと消した!

key: What you know now is hardly all there was,
en: What you know now is hardly all there was,
ja: キミが今知っているのは　ほんの一部

key: ...And yet, it is all there ever shall be again.
en: ...And yet, it is all there ever shall be again.
ja: ……そして　二度と　それ以上は　出てこない

key: ACE: Further, I admit, one bit among that was a surprise even to me...
en: ACE: Further, I admit, one bit among that was a surprise even to me...
ja: エース: それに　あの中の一つは　俺にとっても　驚きだった……

key: Investigation is warranted!
en: Investigation is warranted!
ja: 調査が必要だな!

key: Nevertheless, I said I'd be along to assist-- I never specified who I would be assisting.
en: Nevertheless, I said I'd be along to assist-- I never specified who I would be assisting.
ja: とはいえ　手を貸すとは言ったが　誰にとは　言っていない

key: As I said, you'll find I'm a bit of a wild card~
en: As I said, you'll find I'm a bit of a wild card~
ja: 言っただろ? 俺は　ちょっとした切り札なのさ～

key: ACE: Reveal #2!
en: ACE: Reveal #2!
ja: エース: 種明かし　その2!

key: 'Twas a ruse of comfort, to lure you into separation and numbers!
en: 'Twas a ruse of comfort, to lure you into separation and numbers!
ja: あれは安心させるための策　キミたちを分断し　数で囲むためのな!

key: It was not in a few seconds that the assembly behind you gathered.
en: It was not in a few seconds that the assembly behind you gathered.
ja: 後ろの連中が　数秒で集まったわけじゃない

key: And your friend-- the purple hair-- has been swiftly dispatched of!
en: And your friend-- the purple hair-- has been swiftly dispatched of!
ja: そしてキミの友――紫の髪の彼は――もう片付いた!

key: Fret not; he's safe-- secure.
en: Fret not; he's safe-- secure.
ja: 心配するな。彼は無事だ――しっかり確保してある

key: Of this, I would not deceive you.
en: Of this, I would not deceive you.
ja: これについては　キミを欺かない

key: Likewise you may still rest assured of the safety of those children!
en: Likewise you may still rest assured of the safety of those children!
ja: 同じく　あの子どもたちの安全も　保証しよう!

key: What can be harnessed needs not be destroyed.
en: What can be harnessed needs not be destroyed.
ja: 利用できるものを　壊す必要はない

key: ...Not all among us share this value,
en: ...Not all among us share this value,
ja: ……我々全員が　その考えを持つわけじゃないがな

key: But you have my personal gold star guarantee, little hero, none among them will be harmed.
en: But you have my personal gold star guarantee, little hero, none among them will be harmed.
ja: だが　俺が太鼓判を押すよ　小さな英雄。誰一人　傷つけさせない

key: ACE: Reveal #3!
en: ACE: Reveal #3!
ja: エース: 種明かし　その3!

key: No great plan is complete without a recovery!
en: No great plan is complete without a recovery!
ja: 偉大な計画には　立て直しの手が　欠かせない!

key: After all, only a fool expects to be foolproof!
en: After all, only a fool expects to be foolproof!
ja: 完璧を当てにするのは　愚か者だけだからな!

key: And with that, allow me to introduce you to,
en: And with that, allow me to introduce you to,
ja: というわけで　ご紹介しよう

key: How would you say...?
en: How would you say...?
ja: 何と言えばいいかな……?

key: The oldest trick in the book--
en: The oldest trick in the book--
ja: 世界一古い　お決まりの手――

key: ACE: ...The trap door!
en: ACE: ...The trap door!
ja: エース: ……落とし穴!

key: ACE: Well, hopefully that will be enough...
en: ACE: Well, hopefully that will be enough...
ja: エース: さて　これで足りるといいが……

key: ...Inconsolably melancholic.
en: ...Inconsolably melancholic.
ja: ……慰めようもなく　ゆううつだ

key: Caught you! Hm? Never seen a higher-ranking officer before?
en: Caught you! Hm? Never seen a higher-ranking officer before?
ja: 見つけたぞ! ん? 上級幹部を見るのは　初めてか?

key: Curse you!
en: Curse you!
ja: いまいましい奴め!

key: I won't be made a fool of again.
en: I won't be made a fool of again.
ja: 二度と　バカにはされない

key: Watch out! I'm not that innocent!
en: Watch out! I'm not that innocent!
ja: 気をつけな! アタシは　そんなに無邪気じゃないよ!

key: And neither are you.
en: And neither are you.
ja: あんただって　同じでしょ

key: What? Go away already!
en: What? Go away already!
ja: 何よ? もう　あっち行って!

key: FACTORY ATRIUM LOCK 2 DISENGAGED
en: FACTORY ATRIUM LOCK 2 DISENGAGED
ja: 工場アトリウム　ロック2　解除

key: Ah, you're the scoundrel!
en: Ah, you're the scoundrel!
ja: ああ　お前が　あの悪党か!

key: I tried.
en: I tried.
ja: やるだけは　やった

key: I'll just stick to what I can measure.
en: I'll just stick to what I can measure.
ja: 測れるものだけ　相手にしておくよ

key: A switch on the machine opens the case.
en: A switch on the machine opens the case.
ja: 機械のスイッチで　ケースが開くようだ

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押しますか?

key: Who wouldn't?
en: Who wouldn't?
ja: 押すに決まってる

key: Better not...
en: Better not...
ja: やめておこう……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
